criteria.passage: I’d be upfront with them and say we’re still looking into it, but the technical team hasn’t confirmed the cause or given us a solid fix date yet.
criteria.rationale: This clearly and understandably explains the situation and the proposed communication approach.

criteria.passage: I wouldn’t make up a firm commitment just to sound reassuring.
criteria.rationale: This explicitly rejects an unsupported promise and shows the candidate would manage expectations based on verified information.

criteria.passage:
I’d also make sure there’s a clear follow-up plan so the customer isn’t left wondering what’s going on.

And once it’s resolved, I’d check back in to confirm the service is stable and that the interruption isn’t continuing.
criteria.rationale: This provides a follow-up mechanism through a clear plan and a post-resolution check-in to confirm stability.
